title: MQ: undo value_string macros
description:
Wireshark tooling has code checks for validating value_strings and they won't work if value_strings are "hidden" behind macros.
Wrote a few Python scripts to "undo" the macros with search/replace.
Also created a proper hash table for MQCFINT_Parse "value strings", because it wasn't really a value_string, it was just taking advantage of C pointers which is a time bomb waiting to go off.

commits_data.message:
MQ: undo value_string macros

Wireshark tooling has code checks for validating value_strings and they won't work if value_strings are "hidden" behind macros.
Wrote a few Python scripts to "undo" the macros with search/replace.
Also created a proper hash table for MQCFINT_Parse "value strings", because it wasn't really a value_string, it was just taking advantage of C pointers which is a time bomb waiting to go off.
